question: What constitutes the root Kaula attainment in relation to the eight powers, O fair-faced one?
premises: The eight powers are enumerated as part of this attainment.
The attainment of powers is identified with the root Kaula.
inference: The root Kaula is defined as encompassing the attainment of the eight powers.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the eight powers is not specified within this verse alone.
plain_english: And the eight, O fair-faced one, together with the attainment of powers, constitute the root Kaula.
